title: Preserve Navigator keyboard modality and explicit locale across reload

scope.subject: Use browser-native modal lifecycle for Search / Places and synchronize an explicitly chosen locale on the current history entry without touching camera authority or routes.

research_summary: The existing app has a localized Search dialog and shareable language URLs, but a section with aria-modal cannot stop real keyboard focus and an explicit URL language outlives a user language change. Prefer browser-native focus isolation and existing project URL/history owners over libraries or custom overlays, with actual browser transitions as the acceptance oracle.

sources.finding: HTML dialog provides top-layer isolation, focus restoration, and cancel events.
Modal Tab and Shift+Tab wrap intro controls, and Escape restores the opener.
History replaceState updates only the currently displayed URL and preserves current state and navigation length.
Existing app updates URL with URLSearchParams and replaceState, and locale action is separate from phase and journey.
Keep project's current combobox, asynchronous query lifecycle and pending route state; only the modal boundary is missing.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep the integrated native Universe plus Portfolio; a replacement would lose authored deep links.
Reuse the installed browser and React lifecycle, without another drawing or URL authority.
Preserve the installed Search and locale subsystems; existing query and storage policies stay active.
Exercise actual keyboard events and reload through existing Playwright harness.

candidates.source: Installed web platform or existing registry candidate
candidates.reason: Real isolation and native Escape/restore without another library

candidates.name: Existing locale handler and browser History URL update
candidates.source: Installed web platform or existing registry candidate
candidates.reason: The established app query/state writer can update the requested language only.

candidates.name: External command palette replacing existing Search
candidates.source: Installed web platform or existing registry candidate
candidates.reason: The existing product handles custom filters, selection and navigation; a replacement is a needless independent interaction owner.

decision.rationale: Use the existing search renderer and locale owner, with browser-native modal semantics and current document history.
decision.fallback: Do not publish if focus can still escape or locale switch changes unrelated destinations or creates a history entry.
